comparison.objective: Remove a smoke alarm, replace its dead battery, and reseat the alarm level.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-stage removal, battery extraction/insertion, and fixture reseating, not hammer-mediated notch fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Dead cell is at least 6 cm out; fresh cell is within 2 cm of its tray spot; alarm is within 2.5 cm and 15 degrees when reseated.
comparison.reason: Although both are maintenance sequences with small components, this tests intact part exchange and reseating rather than controlled break-off and fragment containment.
